title: Rusty Scooba Tank
body:
Old scooba gear recovered from the ocean. It is a miracle that it still works. Named after Sir Scoobis III. Doubles oxygen.


The Rusty Scooba Tank is an air tank that can be purchased from the Radical Shack for $10,000.

Details

The Rusty Scooba Tank, unlike the refined variant, simply doubles the user's oxygen reserves while equipped. There is no additional functionality.
